results.description: Signalised intersection, 60 veh/km, 30 km/h, shuffle every 20 s, 5 s silence.

results.description: 12 km highway, 4 veh/km, 110 km/h, shuffle every 60 s, 3 s silence.

results.description: Rural road at night, 1 veh/km, shuffle every 60 s, 10 s silence.
